verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself an official, first-party CLI. The docs show a one-line installer, launching with `claude` in a project, and subcommands and flags such as `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp serve` and `claude --teleport`. The CLI follows the Unix philosophy, so you can pipe logs into it, run it in CI or chain it with other tools, and it ships for macOS, Linux and Windows. Community users confirm it is a terminal-based interactive CLI; one reported an unresponsive terminal, but that is a single anecdote and does not contradict that the CLI exists and works. Missing for 10: no full CLI flag/command reference or non-interactive (print/headless) mode details in the evidence.
